```{r Load libraries}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r Load genelist for COPD vs NS-upregulated}
gene_list <- c("CDKN2B", "COL1A2", "CXCL3", "GDF15", "IL17A", "IL1A", "JUNB", "PAX5", "TERT")

gene_ns_up <- bitr(gene_list,
                fromType = "SYMBOL",
                toType = "ENTREZID",
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

gene_ns_up
```


```{r GO enrichment_COPD_vs_NS-up}
#GO Enrichment
ego <- enrichGO(
  gene          = gene_ns_up$ENTREZID,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE
)

head(ego)

#Visualize
dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15)

ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego)

write.csv(ego_df, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/GO_results_COPD_vs_NS_up.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r KEGG analyses_COPD_vs_NS_up}
ekegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = gene_ns_up$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "hsa",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

dotplot(ekegg, showCategory = 15)

ekegg_df <- as.data.frame(ekegg)

write.csv(ekegg_df, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/KEGG_enrichment_results_COPD_vs_NS_up.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
